title: Commercial UX, lifecycle, logistics execution, complaints, client portal, and R&D access change

approval.reason: The seven previously open design gates were explicitly business-approved and implemented as a controlled forward delta; production authorization remains separate.

preservedInvariants: A changed SENT quotation creates a new quotation linked by supersedes_quotation_id
ERP sales orders remain imported read-only facts; no internal order lifecycle
Country Scope remains mandatory authorization and is independent from Local/Global business classification
Capacity remains estimate-only at Standard 900, Ordinary 700, Curved 600 boards/day and 24 hours/day
No capacity reservations, MES, routing, or QC execution
No invented finance or analytics facts
Cancel remains out of V1 unless separately governed
Client Portal authorization is isolated server-side and cannot inherit internal Sales access blindly
R&D receives no pricing, cost, margin, finance, write, approval, or commercial administration access by default

scopeItems.subject: Rename Win Ratio to Sales Conversion Rate
constraints: The governed semantic registry owns the definition and version
React must not calculate the authoritative metric

scopeItems.subject: Present the affected Product Mix dimension as Customer Segment
constraints: This does not authorize a frontend-only label over incompatible source data
The authoritative taxonomy and effective-dating source must be approved

scopeItems.subject: Top Customers by Value and Top Countries by Value
constraints: Show Top 5 first and expose More for an authorized expanded result
The monetary fact, date basis, currency basis, exclusions, and tie behavior must be explicit
Country Scope and DENY apply before ranking

scopeItems.subject: Opportunity lifecycle owns Hot Lead, WON, and LOST
constraints: Opportunity and quotation states must not be conflated
Intermediate stages may be configurable only through an approved governed design
Cancel remains out of V1

scopeItems.subject: Quotation Draft, Submitted, Under Negotiation, Approved, and Sent states
constraints: Exact transitions, guards, actors, approvals, retries, and concurrency require approval
SENT remains immutable
No formal revisions
Changes after SENT use supersedes_quotation_id
Cancel remains out of V1

scopeItems.subject: Logistics execution and shipment tracking milestones
constraints: Required milestones are Ready for Delivery, Shipped, Vessel Departed, and Arrived at Port of Discharge
Required context includes shipment reference, customer, ERP fact link, destination country, status, BL date, port, and arrival/discharge data
No implementation may infer dispatch, POD, delivery confirmation, carrier integration, or accounting semantics

scopeItems.subject: Local/Global business classification
constraints: Local countries are Egypt, Libya, Saudi Arabia, and United Arab Emirates
All other countries are Global
This classification never grants or expands authorization
Country Scope remains the authorization boundary

scopeItems.subject: Standalone Complaints Management
constraints: A complaint may relate to customer, project, ERP fact, product, quotation, and client user only where a governed relation exists
Lifecycle, priority, SLA, assignment, closure, approval, evidence, and notifications must not be invented

scopeItems.subject: External Client Portal
constraints: An external user sees only explicitly authorized customer context
The portal may expose permitted order and shipment facts and the user's own complaint flows only after contracts are approved
Isolation is enforced server-side
External identity, session, provisioning, revocation, and customer binding are explicit
Internal Sales authorization rules must not be reused blindly

scopeItems.subject: R&D view-only technical and product intelligence
constraints: Access is read-only and limited to approved technical/product intelligence
Pricing, cost, margin, finance, write actions, approvals, and commercial administration are omitted by default
Field projection, aggregation, export, and minimum-cohort rules require approval

decisionGateAudit.subject: Customer Segment taxonomy, source authority, ownership, and effective dating
Top-value monetary fact, event/date basis, currency conversion, exclusions, tie behavior, and More pagination
Opportunity stages, configuration ownership, transition guards, reopen behavior, and WON/LOST evidence
Quotation transition graph, actors, approval relation, concurrency, retries, and document/send prerequisites
Shipment aggregate, cardinality, source authority, milestone actors, evidence, amendments, dates, and backdating
Complaint lifecycle, priority, SLA, ownership, assignment, closure, attachments, approvals, and notifications
Client identity provisioning, MFA/session policy, invitation, customer binding, revocation, and recovery
Client Portal order, shipment, complaint, document, export, and attachment permissions and projections
R&D datasets, field projection, aggregation, minimum cohort, drilldown, export, audit, and retention
Local/Global effective date, historical reclassification, snapshot behavior, and reference-data governance

stepImpact.requiredAction: Reconcile domain boundaries, business terminology, material scope, actors, and handoffs
Add external-client and R&D access models; define shipment and complaint permissions without weakening Country Scope or DENY
Update modules, screens, functional actions, and traceability denominators through formal delta history
Design canonical aggregates, relationships, provenance, effective dating, and restricted projections
Use forward-only expand/contract migrations, constraints, indexes, row versions, audit, and outbox changes
Publish a new typed OpenAPI/client version and implement real authorized PostgreSQL-backed operations
Approve and implement new state machines, transaction boundaries, events, retries, idempotency, and concurrency
Update internal UX and add isolated portal/R&D projections with no fake or dead UI
Version semantic metrics, dimensions, rankings, shipment analytics, and access-aware drilldowns/exports
Run targeted security, authorization, migration, performance, observability, backup/restore, and full regression evidence against the new baseline

requiredSequence: CR-001 forward schema, API, runtime, UI, authorization, analytics, and evidence delta applied
Step 12 remains NOT STARTED and requires a separate explicit task
Production remains unauthorized until the real release gates pass
